turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's not waste them. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first.
Don't thank me. I want to know who decided on that zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Then why are we here? Who entered the zero, Hale, and did Owen get a chance to explain himself first?
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"A misunderstanding." Okay. Then withdraw the zero today, because a misunderstanding doesn't belong in a gradebook.
So can we agree he's a good student?
You're leading me, and I've done this for twenty years. His average is 91.2, and that zero is about to cost him a scholarship with a December 1 deadline.
